name: Instant Club Hit (You'll Dance to Anything)

podcast.body: This song, from the 1987 album `Bucky Fellini`, offered a critical perspective on "poser kids" who claimed to be fans of the techno pop prevalent at the time, mocking their superficial engagement with the scene. "This Song, which took a very dim view of all the poser kids who said that they were into the techno pop of the day."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

others.name: The Thing That Only Eats Hippies
